description_en: Queries the connection information about a client based on the ID of the Smart Access Gateway (SAG) APP instance and username of the client account
description_zh: 根据用户名和智能接入网关APP实例ID查询指定用户在线连接列表
kebab_example: aliyun smartag describe-user-online-clients --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --smart-ag-id sag-wfjgn0000000000 --user-name doctest --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeUserOnlineClients

parameters.description_en:
The username of the client account. Usernames of client accounts added to the same SAG APP instance are unique.

For a client account, if you specify the username, you must also specify the password.
parameters.description_zh:
用户名，同一个智能接入网关APP实例下的用户名不可以重复。

用户名和密码相互依赖，若指定用户名则必须指定密码，反之，若指定密码则必须指定用户名。
